description: Mỗi hàng ô trượt từ trái vào, hàng sau trễ 90 ms, trong hàng mỗi ô trễ thêm 20 ms.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio grid-row-sweep, written here): 3 rows × 4 tiles (32 px, 40 px pitch): x −34 → 0 px and opacity 0 → 1, each 560 ms power2.inOut; delay = row × 90 ms + column × 20 ms (800 ms in all). A soft band behind each row glows while it fills (guide). Params: from (−34 px) · row: trễ mỗi hàng (90 ms) · col: trễ mỗi cột (20 ms) · each (0.56 s).
